name: acuity-scheduling
description: Diagnose unavailable Acuity slots from appointment durations, padding, resources, availability and calendar/global booking limits. Use when clients cannot see a time, an apparently empty calendar cannot accept a booking, or you want to check whether proposed scheduling changes will make a requested slot fit. Works from pasted settings and exports to explain blockers and, when requested, show targeted corrections. The supplied settings determine the result; missing details become focused questions. Not for booking appointments, changing an account, sending reminders or general calendar management.
